data.gender_notes: Fathiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘fatha’, meaning ‘to open’. Fathiya is the name given to a woman who opens the way for others or is the first to embark on a new path. In Islamic tradition, it is also believed to be the name of a heavenly river that opens the gates of paradise. The name Fathiya carries the meaning “Opener, Opener of the Heavens” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fathiya usually hope their child will grow to embody opener, opener of the heavens and live with faith, good character and purpose.
